Treasurer's Home
Services and Responsibilities
Collects all property taxes for Shawnee County.
Distributes property tax monies to the state and other taxing districts.
Serves as the bank for the county government.
Operates the County's motor Vehicle department for the State of Kansas.
Allows for an accountable flow of tax funds to departments providing public services.
Mails approximately 73,000 property tax statements and completes more than 200,000 motor vehicle transactions annually.
